decide.choice: keep:the stage lifted muted #B6C2D4 (4.03:1 fix on the lifted field, see the .stage comment); a near-variant of --muted, no role carries it (SPEC §4.2); also self-referential as a role

decide.why: auto match refused: exact --success-text in dark (self-referential)
decide.choice: keep:self-reference: the codemod proposed var(--X) for a declaration OF --X, which is a cycle and makes the property invalid. The stage re-enters dusk on .stage/:root because <html> is data-theme="light" and Stage.jsx sets no data-theme; retire these when the stage root carries data-theme="dark" (W5-a owns Stage.jsx). A role --success-text would also be paper on <html> (Present #1C7350, fails AA on the dusk stage)
